name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for paas_manager

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._comment: Shared kernel (replaces retired core_sdk); provides the app shell templates.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._comment: Fully installed (skip_install lifted, plan M3): auth_sdk is the source of truth for auth. Its route shells generate LoginRoute/RegisterRoute/etc. - the host's own auth pages are deleted in the same commit, so there is no duplicate-route collision. merchants_sdk's app_type.manager session_policy (seller-only -> /main) gates login via the installed auth_session_policy.dart shell.

sdks.name: desktop_sdk
sdks._comment: Native desktop runner scaffolding. Manager inherits pos's desktop role (fold plan): the SDK's app_type.manager block installs windows/ into the host with ${package}-parameterized CMake naming; the build_windows CI flag stays host-side in paas_manager (workflows cannot be SDK-installed - the CI guard blocks workflow deploys). Mirrors pos.json's entry.

sdks.name: productivity_sdk
sdks._comment: Included but not present in original apps

sdks.name: calc_sdk
sdks._comment: Standalone calculator (productivity PR #4); un-gated /calc route, shared by manager and driver.

sdks.name: weather_sdk
sdks._comment: Rebuilt at 1.1.0 (zones PR #4) with adaptive layout: minimal widget on phones, interactive view on large screens. Mirrors launch_manager.json.

sdks.name: revenue_sdk
sdks._comment: Owns the manager income/statistics pages. Its manager templates predate the lib/src/common/ wrap and the core/ install drop, so they need rewriting before they compile; and its role-specific code belongs under a manager/ folder with an app_type.manager manifest block, not at lib/src/ root.

sdks.name: zones_sdk
sdks._comment: Manager merchant delivery-zone page, declared under app_type.manager. Shared with driver.json, which takes the app_type.driver page from the same manifest.

sdks.name: hms_sdk
sdks._comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk (SDK module, not productFlavors). Dart-side: DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and an order-30 boot hook that, ONLY on GMS-free HMS-capable devices, boots Push Kit and registers the HMS push token through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses (provider 'hms'). No installs - the BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect Gradle wiring lives statically in core's android template, default-off. Strict no-op in every plain GMS build.

_host_routes_comment: Deliberately empty, declared explicitly (supacharge precedent): paas_manager tracks NO router copy after migration M5 - compose generates app_router.dart wholly from base_sdk's template plus each installed SDK's manifest routes. Every former host-owned route migrated to an SDK manifest (auth_sdk's login/register/reset, comms_sdk's /list-notification; the /view_map + /search_map host map pages were deleted, decision D5). Anything ADR-005-shaped a future manager feature needs goes HERE as data, never back into a tracked router file.
